record.name: 409/499 Illinois Street
names: Mission Bay Education Center and Dental Clinics
record.summary: Two buildings tracked as one record, their mapped footprints sharing DataSF Building Footprints id SF3940003: 499 Illinois Street (the southern footprint), a 6-story biotechnology building (its structural engineer describes a 500,000 sq ft center in two buildings) completed 2008 and owned by Alexandria (SF Standard: "long-time landlord Alexandria Properties") until UCSF bought it; and 409 Illinois Street (the northern footprint), which SF Standard says was bought from the same landlord together with 499 Illinois St for $767,000,000 (closing on December 17, 2025) and which UCSF plans to renovate into a new School of Dentistry and a shared education center for students in dentistry, medicine, nursing, pharmacy and physical therapy (the university's project title is Mission Bay Education Center and Dental Clinics). UC filed a Notice of Exemption on May 7, 2026 for an "Advanced Work Phase" of site preparation, and American School & University (September 8, 2026) says "Early construction activities are underway". That magazine reports a completion date targeted for late 2029; SF Standard reports the building is expected to be ready for occupants in the first quarter of 2029. The City's 2006 building permit #200607186938 lists both 409 and 499 Illinois St and shows status "complete" with a completed date of 2009-04-06 (a permit closure date; the permit does not say what stands at 409 today). SF Standard says 409 "will get a 'gut remodel,'" while "only minor work is needed at the other building"; no source read dates the start of the main renovation. The record's status, complete, rests on the 2008 completion of 499 and the 2009 permit closure for both addresses; the 409 renovation is not complete, and the "under construction" milestone below is an expected one that rests on the early work only. UCSF's Valley Center for Vision at 490 Illinois St is a separate record, across Illinois St.

notes.accuracy_caveat: REAL lot geometry -- the outline is Assessor lot 3940003 (15,223 m2, active), so its edges are recorded lot lines, not a surveyed building footprint: it includes any yard, setback or plaza inside the lot and can sit a little off the walls. The lot is condominium-mapped: 3 Assessor lots share this outline (the map lot 3940003 and 2 per-unit lots), so the outline is the building's shared lot, not any one unit. Until 2026-10-12 this record showed the two surveyed building footprints (DataSF Building Footprints, mblr SF3940003); 98% of that outline lies inside the lot and it covered 55% of the lot. The lot also takes in the courtyard and yard between the two buildings and a strip of the neighbouring parks P23 and P24; those two park outlines were trimmed back to this lot's edge on the same date, so the records no longer overlap.

open_questions: This record combines two footprints that share one DataSF Building Footprints id (SF3940003): 499 Illinois St (south) and 409 Illinois St (north). It was formerly named '490/499 Illinois Street' and also carried UCSF's Valley Center for Vision at 490 Illinois St, which is the building across Illinois St on block 33 and now has its own record (corrected 2026-10-10).
Exact month/day of the 2008 completion of 499 Illinois St is not sourced, only the year.

The 2006 construction permit's own block/lot for 499 Illinois St (block 3940, lot 001) differs from the lots the Assessor now uses (lot 3940004, addressed 499 Illinois St, and lot 3940005, addressed 409 to 499 Illinois St). DataSF shows lot 3940001 as retired, with a recorded drop date of 2009-06-04, so the permit used a lot that has since been dropped; the address, biotechnical/medical-research-facility description, 6 stories, and $90M cost all line up with this parcel, so this is treated as the same building under a later lot number, not a different building. The permit's own completion sign-off (2009-04-06) also runs slightly later than the Assessor's 2008 year, which may reflect a lag between substantial completion and permit closeout.

2026-09-28: exact month/day for 409 Illinois St's 2026 renovation start, and the completion date within 2029, are not given by any source found: American School & University magazine (2026-09-08) says 'a completion date targeted for late 2029', while SF Standard (2025-12-17) says construction 'is expected to take about three years and be ready for occupants in the first quarter of 2029'. No project cost is shown because the one source is inconsistent with itself: Construction Dive (published September 1, 2026) says in its headline and text that the project "will cost approximately $278 million, per a prequalification notice on the project from the university", while the page's own project box lists "Value: $287 million". Neither is a contract amount, and the source does not say whether either covers construction alone or the whole project. No source read gives an SF Planning case number for this renovation; CEQAnet's notices list the University of California as the agency, and no source read says whether local planning review applies. DataSF Parcels, read 2026-10-11, lists three active lots on block 3940 with Illinois St addresses: lot 3940003 (409 Illinois St), lot 3940004 (499 Illinois St) and lot 3940005 (409 to 499 Illinois St), all with the same outline and all recorded as added on 2009-06-04. Lot 3940001, which the 2006 permit used, is retired. No source read says which lot the Assessor treats as 499 Illinois St's own or why three active lots share one outline.

No source read says who developed 499 Illinois St. SF Standard (2025-12-17) says UCSF's clinics, labs and offices leased space at 499 Illinois 'for more than a decade' and occupied 90% of the building before buying it.

Size of 409 and 499 Illinois St: 499 Illinois St has six stories per its 2006 DBI permit (its structural engineer, SGH, describes two five-story buildings over two levels of parking). SGH describes a 500,000 sq ft center in two buildings; SF Standard (2025) says 409 and 499 together add up to 470,000 sq ft; UC's own December 2025 acquisition filing gives about 525,421 rentable sq ft for 409 and 499 combined, on 3.6 acres with a 587-space shared garage. 409 Illinois St's renovation into the School of Dentistry / Interprofessional Education Center is 261,117 gross sq ft.
